newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: Slovak SAX index firms on IRB gains.
newsitem.headline: Slovak SAX index firms on IRB gains.

text.p: Another round of gains to shares of IRB Bank helped firm the Bratislava Stock Exchange's (BSE) 16-share SAX index 0.20 points to 170.56, in what otherwise was a disappointing session.
IRB gained 110 crowns to close at 1,370, an eight percent gain over Wednesday's close, continuing a trend begun on Monday.
"This growth appears connected to repo trades and indicates something is happening, but we don't know what," said Peter Krutil of Creditanstalt Bank.
"This is not a normal phenomenon, especially in view of IRB's half-year loss of some 700 million crowns," he added.
The rest of the market activity drifted through the sluggish session in small volumes, even in direct trades, the main motor of BSE activity.

"There are few sellers and buyers and most of the action comes from foreign traders and investors," Krutil said. "Domestic players are looking for profits on the money market where rates are around 20 percent."
Overall volume of shares traded fell to 164,969 from 665,993 stocks traded on Wednesday, while turnover rose to 65.841 million crowns from 32.523 million crowns.
